response.sql: SELECT e.status AS status, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) AS avg_amount_minus_spent, COUNT(*) AS budget_line_count FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.spent > 6.0 GROUP BY e.status

assumptions.assumption: 'Higher-spending' with cutoff 6.0 means strictly spent > 6.0, so lines with spent exactly 6.0 are excluded.
The status is event.status from the joined event, not budget.event_status. Groups are by that value.
The count is of all budget lines that pass the cutoff in each status group, including any with a null amount. AVG ignores nulls and returns NULL if none.
